name: Sky
self_text: Hey! I’m in my early 30s, an Indian economics grad who’s now studying programming. I love working through problems together and need complete silence while I code. I’m happy to explain things when I tutor. I can meet in person or online, and I’m free on Saturday morning or Saturday afternoon. Off the clock, I’m an amateur astronomer who enjoys stargazing.

requests.request_text: I need you to be the one who has things explained by me and you must also be into a step‑by‑step walkthrough session. I'd strongly prefer that you are into language practice, though it's not a requirement, and a small bonus if you are okay with occasional short exchanges or complete silence while working. It would matter a lot if you are available Saturday afternoon or Saturday morning, but I won't rule you out over it.
